story.title: Ava's Robot Workshop
story.introLine: Welcome to the shiny Robot Workshop, Ava! Let's help our metal friends get ready for the big parade.
story.closingLine: Great job, Ava! Now, can you help me count exactly how many parts we need to fix the next robot?

scenes.title: The Sparky Assembly Line
scenes.narration: Look at all these friendly robots! Some have round heads and others have square ones. We need to see how many there are altogether to make sure no one is left behind. Let's count them up!
scenes.imagePrompt: A bright, colorful workshop with friendly, smiling robots of different shapes on a conveyor belt, polished 2d children educational game art.

scenes.title: The Tool Chest Challenge
scenes.narration: Oh no! We have ten shiny wrenches but twelve robots. Do we have enough for everyone, or are we missing some? Let's compare our tools to our robot friends to find out the difference!
scenes.imagePrompt: A cheerful robot holding a toolbox next to a group of waiting robots, vibrant colors, soft lighting, polished 2d children educational game art.
